message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes ever. He was born on December 30, 1984, and played high school ball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School in Akron, Ohio—where he earned national attention before being drafted first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003.

He has had a storied NBA career with three teams:

* **Cleveland Cavaliers (2003–2010)** – where he won Rookie of the Year and led the team to its first playoff appearance since 1995.
* **Miami Heat (2010–2014)** – winning two championships (2012 & 2013) alongside Dwyane Wade and Chris Bosh.
* **Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present)** – capturing his fourth title in 2020 during the bubble season.

Beyond titles, LeBron’s accolades include four MVP awards, multiple All-Star selections, and numerous scoring/assists records. Off the court, he's known for philanthropy—including opening the “I PROMISE” program for underprivileged youth—and ventures into film production and media ownership.
